content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

Selling Notion templates for crypto is about leveraging decentralized payment systems to bypass traditional banking barriers. In countries with limited access to payment processors, using crypto opens a gateway for creators. This model not only ensures that you can reach a global audience but also protects your profits from high platform fees. By utilizing NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies at a minuscule 0.5% fee compared to platforms like Gumroad, which can charge 10%. This difference is critical for creators looking to maximize their income.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture involves a combination of free tools, specifically designed to streamline the payment and delivery process. Using platforms such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, and Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, you can create a fully operational store. Products sold can be managed through Supabase or Google Sheets, which serve as your order storage solutions. This setup enables you to automate product delivery while maintaining complete ownership of your data. The integration with NOWPayments ensures that you can accept crypto payments seamlessly and efficiently.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically built for digital creators who find themselves locked out of conventional platforms. It serves those in regions like Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela, where Stripe and PayPal are either unavailable or severely restricted. By opting for this model, creators can take control of their transactions without dealing with excessive fees. This is especially beneficial for those selling digital products like ebooks, courses, or templates, allowing them to focus on creating content rather than navigating cumbersome payment processes.
Retain more earnings by avoiding platforms with steep fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The core components of a successful setup include a reliable hosting service, a backend logic tool, an efficient database, and a payment processor. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as the hosting environment, while Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers facilitate backend functionality. Supabase or Google Sheets acts as your data repository, and NOWPayments handles the payment processing. These elements work in harmony to create a seamless experience from product listing to transaction completion, ensuring that you maintain ownership and control over your digital store.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first choose your hosting service—GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to manage functionalities such as order processing. Use Supabase or Google Sheets for storing information related to product sales. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to facilitate crypto payments for your customers. By following these steps, you can launch your digital store and start selling your Notion templates with minimal hassle and maximum profit retention.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Complete data ownership means no third-party interference in your sales.

Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more information.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
